On October 19, 2026, Veradermics, Incorporated (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing positive topline data from the Phase 3 clinical trial, Study ‘304’ evaluating VDPHL01 in males with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.

A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and the presentation the Company presented on a conference call and webcast held to discuss the Study ‘304’ topline data is furnished as Exhibit 99.2 to this Current Report on Form 8-K, and both are incorporated by reference herein.
On October 19, 2026, the Company announced positive topline data from the Phase 3 clinical trial, Study ‘304’ evaluating VDPHL01 in males with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.

Treatment with VDPHL01 was generally well tolerated through Month 6, with an overall safety profile consistent with topline findings from Part A of the Company’s Phase 2/3 clinical trial, Study ‘302’ evaluating VDPHL01 in males with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.
